parsed.main_gap: The subset-sum pigeonhole bound (11) does not follow from the stated count of proper subset sums and gaps.

errors.description: There are 2^{n+1}-2 listed sums and 2^{n+1}-3 consecutive gaps, whose total being less than 1 only yields a gap below 1/(2^{n+1}-3), not at most 1/(2^{n+1}-1). The argument is readily repaired by including the empty and full subset sums.
errors.quote:
They lie in $(0,1)$, so their $2^{n+1}-3$ consecutive gaps sum to less than $1$. When put in nondecreasing order, two consecutive subset sums therefore differ by at most
\[
\frac1{2^{n+1}-1}=d. \tag{11}
\]

parsed.notes: Apart from this local counting error, the game-value reduction, pairing interpretation, graph lower bound, refinement construction, and use of the resulting close subsets are coherent and establish the claimed formula.
